notes.title: New DLC! Thin and Fit is now available!
notes.notes:
[h1]AI Solitaire - Thin and Fit[/h1]

[b]AI Solitaire - Thin and Fit[/b] provides 3 new decks to use with AI Solitaire! This DLC is themed around beautiful girls with lean bodies. If you prefer your women with a more natural style, this is the DLC for you!

This DLC was made after reading a review from one faithful fan of [b]AI Solitaire[/b]. A user named [b]Crogar[/b] Gave us a great review after playing more than 200 hours. In it he refered to our game as "Silicone Solitaire" due to the abundance of well-endowed women who are a common theme in some of our card decks. We laughed out loud on reading the review. We can see what he means and we are happy to take honest feedback from anyone, but especially from someone with 200 hours of playtime! He ended the review with the following paragraph:

[h3]"In the rare instances where the developer created normal breasts the result is pure perfection. I highly recommend this game, both for virgin teenage boys who think gigantic breasts are the hottest thing in the world, and for mature who truly enjoy and exception solitaire game."[/h3]

Well, Crogar, this deck was created specifically with you in mind. We hope you enjoy a healthy dose of "pure perfection!"

Sincerely,

Denki Gaka

P.S. For the "virgin teenage boys" out there, next week we will be releasing an actual deck devoted to "Silicone Solitaire." The next DLC is called AI Solitaire - Boob Lover and features breasts in three sizes: Enormous, Gigantic, and Ludicrous!

notes.title: Single Ladies Aisha DLC is out now!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44993133/8f73dd1c711a9cd701f8db10b6c9ac98b38cd36c.png[/img]

[h1]Single Ladies Aisha DLC[/h1]

We ran into a problem when we tried to get the Single Ladies Season Pass we announced approved. Because some of the content was yet to be finished, and the intended content included images meant for more mature audiences, Steam "blocked" the approval of our Season Pass store page. Unfortunately, that block caused a log jam on all of the Single Ladies DLC packs we had submitted, as well.

Blocking the individual girl DLC packs was an unintended result of the block on the season pass. The good news is that the problem is finally resolved. The bad news is that it took more then two months to get it resolved.

So now we have three girls (Aisha, Diana, and Casey) approved for release. We are releasing Aisha today (8/17), Diana on Tuesday (8/20), and Casey on Friday (8/23). Now that the approval process for our store pages is back on track, we will be releasing additional girls as soon as they are approved until we catch up with the intended release schedule of one girl every Wednesday. It will take several weeks to get back to our intended release schedule, but that means that we will often be releasing more than one girl per week.

As for the Season Pass, we are out of luck on that. However, we can create a discounted bundle that includes each girl as we release her. We are working to get that set up right now, but we have never used this kind of bundle before, so we will see how long that takes to get setup and approved. The way that bundle will work is that it will offer a steep discount for buying the complete collection versus the individual pricing. You will only pay for any content you are missing when you first purchase it, and as new DLC in the series are added, you can update your bundle by purchasing only the new content at the same discount as the rest of the bundle.

A bundle is not the way we wanted to do this series, but it is the only option currently available to us.

If you have been waiting for new content, grab Aisha today. Keep an eye out for Diana and Casey next week, and the Bundle of all the Single Ladies as soon as we can get it approved.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44993133/2902117c54b1feeea4975a01c8fd63c6a6c08778.png[/img][h1]Single Ladies Preview Pack DLC[/h1]

In anticipation of our upcoming season of [b]Single Ladies[/b] content, today we released our new DLC: [b]Single Ladies Preview Pack[/b]! It contains thirty(30) awesome decks for one low price!

Eighteen(18) decks feature all fifty-three ladies from our upcoming [b]Season One[/b]. Each of these decks showcase the ladies in different themes and art styles.

Twelve(12) of the decks feature "Miss AI," our spokesmodel Missie. Missie is the girl featured on the title screen for [b]AI Solitaire[/b]. These decks are representative of the types of decks you can expect each week during season: One girl per deck. One theme per deck. One art style per deck. We included twelve(12) decks to give you a better idea of what you can expect when we open up voting for future girls during [b]Season One[/b]!

This DLC will be included with the purchase of the Season Pass, so we will send a discount to cover the cost for anyone who purchases it before [b]Season One[/b] releases! And if you aren't ready to commit to a full year of DLC, this Preview Pack is a great way to get thirty(30) awesome decks for a low price!

notes.title: AI Solitaire is Available Now!
notes.notes:
Whew! It has been a long road to get here. [b]AI solitaire[/b] was first submitted to the Steam store in January of last 2023. After more than three weeks of waiting in the review queue with only cryptic messages saying that the review was going to take longer than expected we recieved a letter from Valve's legal team saying that our game looked great and would probably be a big success; however, due to the unsettled nature of the legal standing of generative AI art they were rejecting our game. WHAT?!?

More than a year later, after trying Itch, Patreon, Deviant Art, and forum posts, this awesome game only had a few hundred loyal followers. It just goes to prove how important Steam is in the distribution of modern PC games. So, when Steam announced a change in policy towards AI, there was much rejoicing at [b]Bikini Beach Games[/b]!

Even so, any product with AI content gets intense scrutiny and takes much longer to get approved. When we resubmitted our much improved game, we set the release date to May 17th, 2024. With more than a month to clear all the review hurdles, we figured we were golden, but we only recieved final approval to release on Tuesday of this week! Cutting it pretty close, right! 

The good news is that [b]AI solitaire[/b] is available right now! [b]AI solitaire[/b] is free and always will be! and [b]AI solitaire[/b] is awesome! 

What are you waiting for? Click that Play Now button and give it a try!  PLEASE!!!!

The only bad news is that the delay on the approval put a stumbling block in getting the DLC store pages approved, so we are launching with no DLC available today, but we were too excited to finally be able to release that we just couldn't wait any longer! 

We have a [b]SOLITAIRE FAVORITES[/b] DLC that will give you an additional 18 versions of solitaire including: [b]FREECELL[/b], [b]CANFIELD[/b], [b]GOLF[/b], [b]EAGLE WING[/b], and [b]YUKON[/b]!

We also have five additional image card deck DLC bundles ready for release, as soon as we get approval:
[b]AI Solitaire - Anime Cuties[/b] provides 12 new decks to use with AI Solitaire! This DLC is themed around beautiful girls in an anime style.
[b]AI Solitaire - Lovely Ladies[/b] provides 12 new decks to use with AI Solitaire! This DLC is themed around beautiful girls in a photorealistic style.
[b]AI Solitaire - Painted Ladies[/b] provides 12 new decks to use with AI Solitaire! This DLC is themed around beautiful women rendered in the style of traditional fantasy art paintings.
[b]AI Solitaire - Handsome Heroes[/b] provides 12 new decks to use with AI Solitaire! This DLC is themed around handsome men in a variety of artistic styles ranging from phtorealistic to comic book styles.
[b]AI Solitaire - Single Ladies - Preview Pack[/b] provides 20 new decks to use with AI Solitaire! This DLC is a preview of our [b]Single Ladies - Year One Season Pass[/b]. Ten of the decks feature each of our 53 ladies in a single artstyle. The other ten decks feature Miss AI (Missie), our product spokesmodel in ten decks that show the range of content you would recieve for each girl every week for a year. 

That last one is a hint of what's coming on [b]July 1st[/b]! We will be releasing a [b]Season Pass[/b] to our [b]Single Ladies[/b] collection. It will feature a new girl each week for a year! Every week you will get six new decks featuring one lovely lady, and you can even vote in the forums for which deck styles we will include!

Keep checking back. Great things are [b]Coming Soon![/b]
